Engine loop: racing car engine sound loops — domasx2
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/racing-car-engine-sound-loops

https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Retrieved: 2026-11-03. loop_0.wav copied without modification as engine-loop.wav.
The source describes a public-domain engine recording edited into a short loop.
In-game playback changes pitch, filtering and volume according to the driving state.
This is a generic engine sound, not a recording of the named cars in the game.
Road/tyre texture is generated by the game; existing impact audio is retained.
